en.title: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent
en.summary: Ukraine's president expressed support for a proposed energy ceasefire, while Russia has not yet responded to the proposal.

en.title: Andy Burnham pledges full transparency over Manchester City meetings
en.summary: The prime minister committed to disclosing complete information regarding his interactions with Manchester City.

stories.title: Houthis warn airlines and passengers not to use Riyadh airport after attack kills 12 people

en.title: Houthis warn airlines and passengers not to use Riyadh airport after attack kills 12 people
en.summary: Following an attack that killed 12 people, Houthis issued warnings to airlines and passengers regarding Riyadh airport. The attack was the third strike on the airport that week.

en.title: UK prime minister say it is 'clear' Russia interfered in 2016 Brexit referendum
en.summary: The UK prime minister stated that Russian interference in the 2016 Brexit referendum is evident.

stories.title: Andy Burnham to publish all details of his dealings with Manchester City

en.title: Andy Burnham to publish all details of his dealings with Manchester City
en.summary: The prime minister will release comprehensive information about his previous interactions with Manchester City following scrutiny over his support for the club after a financial regulations breach.

stories.title: ‘We make our own noise’: Maresca hails Manchester City after Liverpool triumph

en.title: 'We make our own noise': Maresca hails Manchester City after Liverpool triumph
en.summary: Manchester City defeated Liverpool 3-0 at Anfield in their first match following a guilty verdict on 114 Premier League financial rule violations. Manager Enzo Maresca praised the team's response to controversy surrounding the club.

stories.title: Erling Haaland responds after Man City thrash Liverpool under shadow of Premier League sanction

en.title: Erling Haaland responds after Man City thrash Liverpool under shadow of Premier League sanction
en.summary: Manchester City won 3-0 against Liverpool at Anfield in their opening fixture after the Premier League announced a guilty verdict against the club on financial charges.

stories.title: Doku delights as Manchester City cruise past 10-man Liverpool

en.title: Doku delights as Manchester City cruise past 10-man Liverpool
en.summary: Manchester City secured a 3-0 victory over Liverpool at Anfield following their guilty verdict on Premier League financial rule breaches, extending their unbeaten league start to six matches.

stories.title: Ukraine-Russia war latest: Zelensky says Putin struck energy targets hours after Trump ‘ceasefire’ announcement

en.title: Ukraine-Russia war latest: Zelensky says Putin struck energy targets hours after Trump 'ceasefire' announcement
en.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky reported that Putin launched attacks on energy infrastructure shortly after Trump announced a potential ceasefire. The proposed agreement has not yet been confirmed by either Ukraine or Russia.

stories.title: Burnham to release details of Man City meetings

en.title: Burnham to release details of Man City meetings
en.summary: Andy Burnham has faced criticism over comments he made regarding Manchester City's guilty verdict on all Premier League financial rule breach charges. He plans to release details of meetings related to this matter.

stories.title: Riyadh airport hit again after deadly Houthi missile attack, Saudi authorities say

en.title: Riyadh airport hit again after deadly Houthi missile attack, Saudi authorities say
en.summary: A projectile struck terminal 4 at King Khalid airport in Riyadh on Sunday, the day after Houthi rebels killed 13 people in a missile attack on the same facility. The incident caused a fire and injuries, according to Saudi authorities.

stories.title: Andy Burnham says it is clear Russia interfered in Brexit referendum

en.title: Andy Burnham says it is clear Russia interfered in Brexit referendum
en.summary: Andy Burnham stated that Russia interfered in the 2016 Brexit referendum, having received confirmation of this when he inquired about Kremlin involvement upon entering Downing Street. He did not disclose who provided the confirmation.

stories.title: Trump faces Republican opposition to his diesel deal with Russia’s Putin

en.title: Trump faces Republican opposition to his diesel deal with Russia's Putin
en.summary: Lawmakers from both parties are opposing a diesel agreement between Trump and Putin, arguing it would fund Putin's military campaign in Ukraine and breach US law.

stories.title: EU ‘safeguards’ hybrid car sector from Chinese imports under new deal

en.title: EU 'safeguards' hybrid car sector from Chinese imports under new deal
en.summary: The EU has reached an understanding with Beijing to protect its hybrid vehicle industry from Chinese imports. While the automotive sector backs the arrangement, other industries contend that China's substantial trade surplus requires more comprehensive measures.

stories.title: US hits commercial tanker in Gulf of Oman as tensions flare

en.title: US hits commercial tanker in Gulf of Oman as tensions flare
en.summary: The US military attacked a commercial tanker in the Gulf of Oman, according to Central Command, which stated the vessel attempted to breach an American naval blockade of Iranian ports. This marked the first such attack in approximately one month.

stories.title: US threatens to block arms for Ukraine over attacks on Russian refineries

en.title: US threatens to block arms for Ukraine over attacks on Russian refineries
en.summary: US officials are pressuring European capitals and Kyiv, threatening to withhold military aid to Ukraine in response to attacks on Russian refineries. The pressure follows Trump's fuel supply agreement with Putin.

stories.title: VW chief calls for France and Germany to co-operate on China car fightback

en.title: VW chief calls for France and Germany to co-operate on China car fightback
en.summary: Volkswagen's chief executive urged France and Germany to work together to counter Chinese competition in the automotive market ahead of the Paris Motor Show. He emphasized the companies' history of finding solutions through cooperation.
